set.def: to criticize someone very harshly and angrily, often with insults and in public

why: old def made public hatred the purpose/result of the verb; reviling is the abusive criticism itself

set.def: spoken or performed without a written script, either made up on the spot or prepared but not read word for word
set.note: In public-speaking courses it means prepared ahead but delivered from brief notes, not read from a script.

why: extemporaneous speeches in the public-speaking sense use brief notes; 'given without notes' and the note were inaccurate

cloze.s: Critics accused the TV station of ___ the danger, since the storm turned out to be a light shower.

why: old cloze tested the idiom 'overplay one's hand' (a different sense), not the taught def

cloze.s: Frustrated by her ___ boss, who said yes on Monday and no on Tuesday, Hannah asked for a final decision in writing.

why: old cloze used the verb/gerund ('weeks of vacillating between') not the adjective; 'hesitant' means slow to act, not changing one's mind
'suggestive' mainly means hinting at sex; not a synonym in this sense
'dapper' means neat and trim, lacking the daring/raffish sense
'mediocre' means below standard (negative); unexceptional is neutral ordinary
'admittedly' is a conceding sentence adverb, not 'openly declared'
'insularity' is isolation/narrowness, not judging others by one's own culture
'dented' means pushed in by a blow, not covered with pits or scars
'breed' is not a synonym of domesticate
'hopeless' is not a synonym of 'impossible to get back'
'predecessor' means someone who held a post before you, not an ancestor
'wistfully' means with sad longing, not lonely and without hope
'The group is rabidly against the new mall' fits the cloze
'never accepts results unhesitatingly' fits the cloze
'She unhesitatingly tossed the receipt' fits the cloze
overlapping def (be far better than a rival); 'was outclassed' fits the cloze
def 'hopeless and miserable' overlaps 'sad... no hope'
def 'very sad' overlaps; risk in (a)/(b)
def overlaps (saying what you don't mean vs avoiding truth); could fill the cloze
def 'showing no fear or feeling' overlaps; 'the unblinking goalkeeper' fits cloze
'complained so lustily' (loudly, energetically) fits the cloze
